Alexandre Pierre.note: Watch Pierre for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate clue is how Pierre sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Alexandre Pierre.noteZh: 最能体现Alexandre Pierre特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Carl Sainte.note: The key to Sainté is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. There is another side to his game: he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Carl Sainte.noteZh: Carl Sainté的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Carlens Arcus.note: Watch Arcus for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also notice how Arcus gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Carlens Arcus.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Carlens Arcus踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Danley Jean Jacques.note: Jacques stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Jacques takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Danley Jean Jacques.noteZh: 观察Danley Jean Jacques时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Derrick Etienne.summary: Derrick Etienne Jr. is a Haiti winger who plays for Toronto FC and gives the national team direct carrying, left-side width, and transition speed.
Derrick Etienne.note: Etienne's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Away from that moment, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Derrick Etienne.noteZh: 观察Derrick Etienne Jr.时，可以先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个比赛细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Dominique Simon.note: For Simon, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Also watch how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Dominique Simon.noteZh: 看Dominique Simon的作用，关键是对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Duckens Nazon.note: What separates Nazon is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Nazon arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. In another phase of play, he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Duckens Nazon.noteZh: 看Duckens Nazon的作用，关键是防线重组前制造干净射门。他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Frantzdy Pierrot.club: Çaykur Rizespor (on loan from AEK Athens)
Frantzdy Pierrot.note: For Pierrot, the foundation is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Look first at how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. A separate point is how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Frantzdy Pierrot.noteZh: Frantzdy Pierrot最鲜明的特点是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。一个直接线索是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。另一个独立细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Garven Metusala.note: What separates Metusala is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Metusala waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. At another point, he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Garven Metusala.noteZh: Garven Metusala的比赛建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢之上。首先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个方面是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Hannes Delcroix.note: The key to Delcroix is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. One more thing to notice is how Delcroix checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Hannes Delcroix.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Hannes Delcroix踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Jean-Kevin Duverne.note: Watch Duverne for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. The clearest example is how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Also notice how Duverne turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Jean-Kevin Duverne.noteZh: 多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构是理解Jean-Kévin Duverne踢法的关键。先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.note: Bellegarde's signature is carrying momentum through open midfield. Watch how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Separately, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.noteZh: 观察Jean-Ricner Bellegarde时，可以先看带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个比赛细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Johny Placide.note: What separates Placide is the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. Placide waits for the strike before committing. At another point, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Johny Placide.noteZh: Johny Placide的优势在于耐心判断点球手最后一下动作。最直接的表现是他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Josue Casimir.note: Casimir stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also look at how Casimir looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Josue Casimir.noteZh: Josué Casimir的优势在于带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。最直接的表现是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Josue Duverger.note: Duverger's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Watch how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. For a wider read, also watch whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Josue Duverger.noteZh: 理解Josué Duverger，要先看提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Keeto Thermoncy.note: For Thermoncy, the foundation is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Look first at how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. A separate point is how he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Keeto Thermoncy.noteZh: Keeto Thermoncy最鲜明的特点是对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。一个直接线索是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个独立细节是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Lenny Joseph.note: Joseph stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. In a separate phase, Joseph meets the pass without adding an extra touch.
Lenny Joseph.noteZh: 最能体现Lenny Joseph特点的是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。这一点直接体现在他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。除此之外，他也会迎球直接完成射门，不增加调整触球。

Louicius Deedson.note: For Deedson, the foundation is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Look first at how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also watch how he pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Louicius Deedson.noteZh: 理解Louicius Deedson，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Markhus Lacroix.note: Watch Lacroix for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate clue is how Lacroix slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Markhus Lacroix.noteZh: 理解Duke Lacroix，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Martin Experience.note: Expérience's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Martin Experience.noteZh: Martin Expérience的比赛建立在从后场加入进攻的启动时机之上。首先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个方面是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ricardo Ade.note: What separates Adé is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Adé keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate detail appears when he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Ricardo Ade.noteZh: 最能体现Ricardo Adé特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ruben Providence.note: Providence stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also look at how Providence draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Ruben Providence.noteZh: 观察Ruben Providence时，可以先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Wilguens Paugain.note: The key to Paugain is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In another phase, Paugain waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Wilguens Paugain.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Wilguens Paugain踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Wilson Isidor.note: The key to Isidor is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. One more thing to notice is how Isidor arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Wilson Isidor.noteZh: Wilson Isidor的比赛建立在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动之上。首先看他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个方面是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Woodensky Pierre.note: What separates Pierre is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Pierre waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate detail appears when he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Woodensky Pierre.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Woodensky Pierre踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Yassin Fortune.note: The key to Fortuné is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate part of his game is how Fortuné changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Yassin Fortune.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动构成Yassin Fortuné踢法的核心。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。
